from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

NS = {'hp': 'http://www.hancom.co.kr/hwpml/2010/HWPML'}
ET.register_namespace('hp', NS['hp'])

def local(tag):
    return tag.split('}',1)[1] if tag.startswith('{') else tag

def p_text(p):
    return ''.join((t.text or '') for t in p.findall('.//hp:t', NS))

def remove_layout_cache(p):
    # Remove known layout-cache elements directly under paragraph
    removed = 0
    for child in list(p):
        lname = local(child.tag).lower()
        if lname in ('linesegarray','linesegArray'.lower(),'cache','paracache','linebreakarray','linebreaksegarray'):
            p.remove(child)
            removed += 1
    # Some caches may be nested; remove any descendant hp:linesegarray too.
    for cache in list(p.findall('.//hp:linesegarray', NS)):
        parent = cache
        # find parent by traversal (ElementTree lacks getparent)
        # We'll do a small DFS to locate and remove
    
    # Generic nested removal
    def prune(parent):
        nonlocal removed
        for ch in list(parent):
            lname = local(ch.tag).lower()
            if lname in ('linesegarray','linesegarray','cache','paracache','linebreakarray','linebreaksegarray'):
                parent.remove(ch)
                removed += 1
            else:
                prune(ch)
    prune(p)
    return removed

def set_paragraph_text_single_run(p, new_text):
    ts = p.findall('.//hp:t', NS)
    if not ts:
        # create run+t
        run = ET.SubElement(p, f"{{{NS['hp']}}}run", {'charPrIDRef': '0'})
        t = ET.SubElement(run, f"{{{NS['hp']}}}t")
        t.text = new_text
        return
    ts[0].text = new_text
    for t in ts[1:]:
        t.text = ''

# Load update data
with open('/root/renewal_update.json','r',encoding='utf-8') as f:
    upd = json.load(f)

followups = []
with open('/root/followups.csv','r',encoding='utf-8') as f:
    r = csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in r:
        followups.append((int(row['sequence']), row['item']))
followups.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])

# Parse XML sections
sec0_path = '/root/hwpx_work/Contents/section0.xml'
sec1_path = '/root/hwpx_work/Contents/section1.xml'

t0 = ET.parse(sec0_path)
r0 = t0.getroot()
t1 = ET.parse(sec1_path)
r1 = t1.getroot()

modified_ps = set()  # element ids (python id)

def mark_modified(p):
    modified_ps.add(id(p))

# --- section0 updates ---
for p in r0.findall('.//hp:p', NS):
    txt = p_text(p)

    if txt.startswith('고객사:'):
        # Replace customer name; preserve two-run structure if present
        # Desired full line: 고객사: <customer>
        customer = upd['customer']
        # If there are at least two t nodes, split across first two; else set single
        ts = p.findall('.//hp:t', NS)
        if len(ts) >= 2:
            # split customer on last space to keep two runs
            if ' ' in customer:
                a, b = customer.rsplit(' ', 1)
                ts[0].text = f'고객사: {a} '
                ts[1].text = b
                for t in ts[2:]:
                    t.text = ''
            else:
                ts[0].text = f'고객사: {customer}'
                for t in ts[1:]:
                    t.text = ''
        else:
            set_paragraph_text_single_run(p, f'고객사: {customer}')
        mark_modified(p)

    if txt.startswith('현 담당자:'):
        set_paragraph_text_single_run(p, f"현 담당자: {upd['owner_name']}")
        mark_modified(p)

    if txt.startswith('갱신 윈도우:'):
        set_paragraph_text_single_run(p, f"갱신 윈도우: {upd['window_start']} ~ {upd['window_end']}")
        mark_modified(p)

    if txt.strip() == 'Standard-18M':
        set_paragraph_text_single_run(p, upd['band'])
        mark_modified(p)

        mark_modified(p)

        set_paragraph_text_single_run(p, f"가격 메모: {upd['note']}")
        mark_modified(p)

# Clean layout cache for modified section0 paragraphs
cache_removed0 = 0
for p in r0.findall('.//hp:p', NS):
    if id(p) in modified_ps:
        cache_removed0 += remove_layout_cache(p)

# --- section1 updates ---

    modified_ps1.add(id(p))

# Update renewal window confirmation line and follow-ups

        start_idx = i+1
    if txt.startswith('갱신 윈도우 확인:'):

        # update this line too
        set_paragraph_text_single_run(p, f"갱신 윈도우 확인: {upd['window_start']} ~ {upd['window_end']}")
        mark_modified1(p)
        break

if start_idx is None or end_idx is None or end_idx < start_idx:
    raise SystemExit('Could not locate follow-up block boundaries in section1.xml')

existing = ps[start_idx:end_idx]

# Replace existing follow-up paragraphs with new list
new_lines = [f"{seq}. {item}" for seq,item in followups]

# Reuse min paragraphs
reuse = min(len(existing), len(new_lines))
for i in range(reuse):
    set_paragraph_text_single_run(existing[i], new_lines[i])
    mark_modified1(existing[i])

# If extra existing paragraphs, remove them
for p in existing[reuse:]:
    # remove from root
    r1.remove(p)

# If need more paragraphs, clone the last existing paragraph (or first) structure
if len(new_lines) > len(existing):
    import copy
    template = existing[-1] if existing else ps[start_idx-1]
    # Determine max numeric id in section for unique ids
    max_id = 0
    for p in r1.findall('./hp:p', NS):
        try:

    insert_pos = start_idx + reuse  # after reused ones

        mark_modified1(newp)
        # insert before end_idx paragraph (which has shifted if deletions occurred)

        win_p = None
        for p2 in r1.findall('./hp:p', NS):
            if p_text(p2).startswith('갱신 윈도우 확인:'):
                win_p = p2

        if win_p is None:

        current_ps = list(r1.findall('./hp:p', NS))
        win_i = current_ps.index(win_p)
        r1.insert(win_i, newp)

# Ensure appendix sentence preserved (do nothing, just assert)
appendix_ok = False
for p in r1.findall('.//hp:p', NS):

if not appendix_ok:

# Write back
